title: Owl Cams
html:
Linden Owl Cam Karel | 28 Jul, 2020

We had massive success with the owl cam in Linden! Unfortunately, the breeding season will only begin again in June/July. We will put this camera up again when the owls are preparing to breed. You can view all the footage from this camera on our YouTube channel!

Mziki Owl Cam Karel | 28 Jul, 2020

Verreaux's Eagle Owl breeding will begin between March and September. Currently this camera is down as there is no activity. We'll keep you updated closer to the Verreaux's breeding season!
